title: Sportswear HO19 / Explore Strada repeated shoe collage

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Sportswear Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Repeat one product at changing angles so viewers can follow its silhouette through a deliberate visual rhythm.
strategic_value: Lime accents on the repeated dark shoes can make Explore Strada identifiable within a textured composition.
demonstration: Five dark shoe cutouts sweep from a large foreground shoe at lower left toward the upper right over a blue-gray distressed field.
practical_value: Choose a direction for repetition that fits a landscape format and keeps the main product large.

content_islands.name: Footwear fan
content_islands.spec: Overlap five cutout shoes diagonally, with the largest at lower left.

content_islands.name: Texture and border
content_islands.spec: Place the shoe fan over blue-gray printed texture inside a pale outer border.
